A single blink became one of the bravest acts of secret communication in military history. In 1966, U.S. Navy pilot and POW Jeremiah Denton was forced into a televised propaganda interview, where he secretly blinked "TORTURE" in Morse code to reveal the abuse American prisoners were suffering. His hidden message became the first confirmed evidence of torture in North Vietnamese captivity.
